'''Clube Desportivo Trofense''' ({{IPA|pt|ˈkluβɨ ðɨʃpuɾˈtivu tɾuˈfẽsɨ}}), commonly known as '''Trofense''', is a Portuguese [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Trofa]], Portugal. Founded in 1930, it plays in [[Liga 3 (Portugal)|Liga 3]], holding home games at ''[[Estádio do Clube Desportivo Trofense]]'', with a capacity of 5,017 spectators.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Instalações – Clube Desportivo Trofense |url=https://cdtrofense.pt/instalacoes/ |access-date=2024-11-13 |website=cdtrofense.pt}}</ref>

Club colours are red and blue (related to the badge)."}}
